description: Fuzzy-search tax-exempt organizations by name, optionally filtered to a US state. Tolerant of word reordering and minor spelling differences. Returns ranked matches with EIN, location, and IRC subsection. Use the returned EIN with nonprofit_details or nonprofit_lookup_ein.

name.description: Organization name or partial name to search for.

state.description: Optional 2-letter US state/territory code to narrow results, e.g. "NY", "TX", "CA".

name: nonprofit_search_name
